decisions.reason: Its upgrade from a mention to a dedicated page by 2024 suggests performance at least met aspiration levels, and as a close-to-core product in a growing, investing firm it merits continued support.
Its stronger 2024 web presence indicates acceptable market feedback relative to aspirations, and the firm has enough related capabilities and slack to continue a closely related condenser offering.

Although it was not more prominently promoted, it stayed on the website and fits the firm's service-and-repair logic, so boundedly rational management would retain this niche extension while results remain uncertain.

A customized industrial air cooler matches the firm's integrated-solution strategy and, in a favorable industry with ongoing expansion, management would likely continue it unless there were clearer signs of underperformance.

This repair insert product builds directly on installed-base service capabilities and likely requires limited dedicated resources, so organizational slack and strategic fit favor keeping it on the market.
